text.en:
No delivery to the consignee shall be authorized by the Collector of Customs, of any large
animal' imported into the Philippines, unless the Director of Animal Industry or his authorized representative
has certified that' said animal has been duly registered and branded with a distinctive mark in the manner
prescribed by the Bureau of Animal Industry.

Any person who shall fail, neglect or refuse to brand or register large animals as herein provided
shall be punished for each animal not branded or registered in' accordance with this Act by a fine of not less
than two hundred pesos nor more than one thousand pesos or by imprisonment of not less than thirty days nor
more than six months, or by both such fine and imprisonment, at the discretion of the court.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 23, 1938.
